figures.page_name: 1 Staff list
figures.heading: Notice and Technician column
figures.alt: Staff list with the notice and the Technician column
captions: Notice, verbatim: "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."
No close button: it disappears for everyone on the "New" pill's end date.

Technician column, read-only and sortable, just left of Billable: Yes when the person's Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise No. A deactivated person always shows No. It changes only through the staff window (page 2).
"New" pill at the top right of the Technician header. It goes away at 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this; the exact date is set when the release is scheduled.
figures.state: Staff list with the blue info notice (i icon, two lines, no close button) between the toolbar and the Active/Deactivated tabs; table scrolled further sideways (Last Name out of view, emails cut on the left); Technician column with a 'New' pill at the top right of its header, directly left of Billable; green Yes / red No pills in both columns (same style); every visible row's Technician value equals its Billable value.

figures.page_name: 2 Turn Technician on for a staff member
figures.heading: Technician role picked
figures.alt: New Staff Member with Time Clock on and the Technician role picked, Technician switched on
captions: Time Clock on and the built-in Technician role picked: Technician switches on by itself. The built-in Foreman role does the same; every other role, including Parts Technician and custom roles, leaves it off.
Changing the role or Time Clock sets it again from the role, until the user switches Technician by hand: from then on their choice wins. Edit Staff Member never does this.

figures.page_name: 3 When Technician can't be turned on
figures.heading: Time Clock off
figures.alt: Technician grayed out with the Time Clock tooltip
captions: Technician needs Time Clock. While Time Clock is off, Technician is off and grayed out. Tooltip, verbatim: "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians."
Turning Time Clock off turns Technician off. Turning Time Clock back on leaves Technician off; the user turns it on.
figures.state: New Staff Member, no role, Time Clock off; pointer on the grayed-out Technician toggle; dark grey tooltip with white text, one line, no arrow, opening BELOW the toggle row and centred under Technician, covering part of the orange billing line.

figures.page_name: 3 When Technician can't be turned on
figures.heading: Built-in Office User role
figures.alt: Technician grayed out with the role tooltip
captions: On the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, Technician is off and grayed out. Tooltip, verbatim: "This role can't be a technician." Picking one of those roles turns Technician off.
Any other role, including a custom role copied from either one, never grays it out.

figures.page_name: 4 Turn Technician off with open work
figures.heading: Turn Off Technician warning
figures.alt: Turn Off Technician warning with the person's name and counts
captions: Save shows this first, only when the person still leads an open work order or is on a line of one (with labor, added with Add Technician, or as the line's technician), at any location. Otherwise Save goes straight on.
Text, verbatim with this demo's counts: "Emily Madden leads 15 open work orders and is on 141 labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."
Cancel, the X or Escape leave the staff member unsaved. Save continues the save. Nothing is unassigned either way.
